verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only vaguely references being able to 'change how you get paid for each of your merchant accounts' (docs-22), but there is no documentation of payout timing visibility, payout schedules, or an option to expedite payouts to next-day/instant speed. missing for 10: payout timing/dashboard visibility, next-day payout option, instant payout option, any documentation of payout speed configuration.
